description: The maintenanceWindow resource provides access to retrieve or update the current Atlas project maintenance window.. Source:- https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/tree/master/cfn-resources/maintenance-window

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml)

AutoDeferOnceEnabled.description: Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud should defer all maintenance windows for one week after you enable them.

DayOfWeek.description:
One-based integer that represents the day of the week that the maintenance window starts.

| Value | Day of Week |
|---|---|
| `1` | Sunday |
| `2` | Monday |
| `3` | Tuesday |
| `4` | Wednesday |
| `5` | Thursday |
| `6` | Friday |
| `7` | Saturday |

ProjectId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project.

HourOfDay.description: Zero-based integer that represents the hour of the of the day that the maintenance window starts according to a 24-hour clock. Use `0` for midnight and `12` for noon.

Defer.description: Flag that indicates whether to defer the maintenance window. When set to true, the next scheduled maintenance will be deferred.

AutoDefer.description: Flag that indicates whether MongoDB Cloud should automatically defer maintenance windows for one week when they occur during the defined maintenance window.

ProtectedHours.description: Protected hours during which MongoDB Cloud cannot start maintenance.

StartHourOfDay.description: Hour of the day when protected hours start (0-23).

EndHourOfDay.description: Hour of the day when protected hours end (0-23).

title: MongoDBAtlasMaintenanceWindowProperties
